title: Body Hero Exfoliating Body Bar

specifications.Breadcrumbs: Scrub & Exfoliants > Bath & Shower > Bath & Body

descriptionHtml:
✓ Cruelty-Free

What it is: An ergonomically designed, no-mess body-scrub bar that fits in the palm of your hand and sloughs away dead skin and dryness to reveal baby-smooth skin.


Highlighted Ingredients:
- Naturally Derived Cellulose and Bamboo Powder: For gentle but effective exfoliation.

- Sunflower Seed Oil: Rich in linoleic acid and vitamin E to lock in moisture.

- Aloe Leaf Juice: Rich in antioxidants with hydrating and dry-skin-soothing properties.


Ingredient Callouts: It is cruelty-free.

How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Wet skin first, then gently massage onto the body in circular motions.
-Add one or two pumps of Daily Oil Wash to bring an extra boost of soothing moisture.
-Rinse well.
-Follow up with Dry Touch Oil Mist or Daily Perfecting Lotion (each sold separately).
Ingredients+
-Naturally Derived Cellulose and Bamboo Powder: For gentle but effective exfoliation.
-Sunflower Seed Oil: Rich in linoleic acid and vitamin E to lock in moisture.
-Aloe Leaf Juice: Rich in antioxidants with hydrating and dry-skin-soothing properties.

Sodium Oleate, Sodium Stearate, Sodium Cocoate, Water/Aqua/Eau, Cellulose Acetate, Glycerin, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Fragrance/Parfum, Bambusa Arundinacea Stem Extract, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Tetrasodium Iminodisuccinate, Maltodextrin, Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891), Iron Oxides (CI 77491, CI 77499), Linalool, Geraniol, Limonene, Citronellol.
